content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2: the only policy-compliant plan that reaches the 80% target, at 80.9% for 13:45-17:30, for ₹1,473.","why":"Calls on the general queue are running above forecast because of the 09:00 pre-approved loan email (MKT-2026-551). Over the last four intervals there were 307 calls against 236 forecast, mostly loan and new-offer enquiries, and service level fell to 68% at 09:45. Staffing is on plan, so this is extra demand, not a staffing problem. R2 delays breaks on both queues and cancels general coaching from 15:45 to 16:45. It moves 3 cross-skilled agents from payments to general from 15:00 to 17:00, plus 3 more from 16:00 to 17:00. It also adds 20% chat deflection of new-offer enquiries, overtime for 3 general agents from 15:00 to 16:00, and IVR callbacks on both queues. Predicted service level for 13:45-17:30 is 80.9% (general 79.2%, payments 83.2%), abandons are 4.5%, and the rest of the day is 84.5%. No escalation is needed.","trade_offs":["Cost: the no-cost plan P1 (79.6%) and R1 (79.7%, ₹1,113) both fall just short of 80%. R2 costs ₹360 more than R1 to clear the target.","Customer impact: R2 leaves general at 79.2%, just under target on its own. The overall figure is lifted by payments. P2 (87.5%, ₹1,077) and P3 (86.9%) serve customers better but break policy CX-01: they use a known-issue IVR message without a confirmed outage, which would mislead loan callers.","Risk to payments: R2 borrows up to 6 payments agents and delays payments breaks. Payments is predicted to drop to 83.2%, from 84.8% with no action.","Margin is thin: 80.9% is only 0.9 points above target."],"watch":"Watch the payments queue from 16:00, when the second group of 3 agents moves over. Be ready to send agents back if payments falls toward 80%. Also check that the overtime is actually taken up for 15:00-16:00; without it, R2 likely falls back toward R1's 79.7%."}
